blocks.source: いわゆるオムニバス形式の作品で、「原始編」「幕末編」など、主人公や時代・世界観の異なるシナリオが７つ存在する。全主人公のシナリオをクリアすると「中世編」を選択できるようになり、さらに、その中世編をクリアすると、好きなキャラクターを主人公にした上で「最終編」に移ることになる。
blocks.translation: This is what is known as an omnibus-style game, with seven scenarios featuring different protagonists, eras, and settings, including the “Prehistory Chapter” and “Bakumatsu Chapter.” Once you clear the scenarios for all the protagonists, the “Medieval Chapter” becomes available, and after clearing that chapter, you move on to the “Final Chapter” with a character of your choice as the protagonist.

blocks.source: 各編、それぞれ異なった良さがあるが、「近未来編」など全体的に熱いシナリオやセリフが多い。かと思えば、ホラー要素のある「ＳＦ編」もあったりとメリハリが効いている。「幕末編」は遊び心が豊富で、ファミコン時代ならば、これだけで一作品作れそうなクオリティ。
blocks.translation: Each chapter has its own distinct strengths, but many of the scenarios and lines are intense overall, such as the “Near Future Chapter.” At the same time, the game maintains good contrast with the “Sci-Fi Chapter,” which contains horror elements. The “Bakumatsu Chapter” is full of playful touches and has such high quality that, in the Famicom era, it could have been made into a complete game on its own.

blocks.source: そして何よりも、中世編の展開や最終編でのラストバトルが印象深い。ＸＸがＸＸになるシナリオを思いつくのは簡単なことだが、それをゲームシステム的にも破綻させずに完成させることは至難の業。この作品はそれを高い完成度で実現している。
blocks.translation: Above all, the developments in the Medieval Chapter and the final battle in the Final Chapter are deeply memorable. Coming up with a scenario in which XX becomes XX is easy, but bringing it to completion without making the game system fall apart is extremely difficult. This game accomplishes that with a high degree of polish.

blocks.source: システム・バランス・快適性
７×７のマス目形式でシミュレーション要素を持った戦闘システムが特徴。
blocks.translation: Its distinctive feature is a battle system with simulation elements, played on a 7×7 grid.

blocks.source: ＭＰの概念が存在せず、覚えた技は使い放題。技毎に「効果」「範囲」「発動時間」などが異なるので、その都度、有効な技を選ぶというスタイル。といっても、新しく覚えた技の方が大抵強く、同じ技の一辺倒になりやすい部分も。
blocks.translation: There is no concept of MP, so techniques you have learned can be used without limit. Since each technique differs in “effect,” “range,” and “activation time,” among other things, the style is to choose an effective technique each time. That said, newly learned techniques are usually stronger, which can make it easy to rely on the same technique over and over.

blocks.source: 先に「ＭＰが存在しない」と書いたが、他にも、「ＨＰは戦闘終了後に全快する」「移動中ならばどこでもセーブできる」「ほとんどの戦闘は確実に逃げられる」。
blocks.translation: I wrote earlier that “MP does not exist,” but there are other conveniences as well: “HP is fully restored after battle,” “you can save anywhere while traveling,” and “you can reliably escape from most battles.”

blocks.source: などなどリソース管理の要素は薄いが、その分、ゲーム全体としてテンポ良く進む。
blocks.translation: Although elements such as resource management are minimal, the game as a whole moves along at a brisk pace as a result.

blocks.source: 敵・味方のターンが切り替わるタイミングが分かりにくいなど、戦闘システムとしては、荒削りな部分もあって、そこまで完成度が高いわけではない。とはいえ、ＳＦＣ時代のスクウェアＲＰＧらしく、戦闘アニメは豊富でテンポが良く楽しい。何気に技名のセンスが光る。
blocks.translation: As a battle system, it has some rough edges, such as making it difficult to tell when the enemy and ally turns switch, so it is not exceptionally polished. Even so, true to a Square RPG from the SFC era, it has abundant battle animations, a good pace, and is fun to play. The technique names also have an unexpectedly brilliant flair.

blocks.source: 個人的にこういうシミュレーション的な戦闘システムはいずれ追求してみたいと思っているテーマ。まだまだ面白くできる余地はあると思う。
blocks.translation: Personally, this kind of simulation-style battle system is a theme I would like to explore someday. I think there is still plenty of room to make it more interesting.

blocks.source: 各編毎に雰囲気の異なる曲を使用していることが特徴。共通の曲は数曲のみ。いずれも曲のクオリティが高く、全て下村陽子氏が１人で作曲したというのだから驚き。
blocks.translation: A distinctive feature is that each chapter uses music with a different atmosphere. There are only a few shared tracks. Every one of them is high quality, and it is astonishing that Yoko Shimomura composed them all by herself.

blocks.source: 特に中世編の曲が王道で僕好み。
blocks.translation: I especially like the Medieval Chapter’s music because it is classic and right up my alley.

blocks.source: ゲームシステムに無駄がなく、かつオリジナリティに溢れている。システム・シナリオの双方がうまく機能しており、ゲームデザインとして秀逸。
blocks.translation: The game system is free of unnecessary elements while overflowing with originality. Both the system and the scenarios work together effectively, making this an outstanding example of game design.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ時代のスクウェアは「ルドラの秘宝」「バハムートラグーン」など、例えマイナー作品であっても良作揃いだが、その中でも頭１つ抜けた完成度を持っている。
blocks.translation: Square’s SFC-era games are full of gems, even among lesser-known titles such as “The Treasure of Rudra” and “Bahamut Lagoon,” but this one stands out even among them for its exceptional level of polish.
